title: run exit precedence across child exit, verification, and startup failure
note: A child exit code of 7 is preserved even when verification also fails; both failures are reported on stderr, but the child's code wins (§42.2). Verification failure alone maps to 3 (§42.1). A startup failure — fake-jev cannot start the server or run the child at all — is 2 and takes precedence over both. Each case is a separate execution of this file; the conditions are the input, not a sequence of steps.

conventions.comparison: parsed JSON values; object key order and insignificant number spelling 1 versus 1.0 are not significant (§44 preamble, §39.4)
conventions.messageSentinel: the literal string <not asserted> marks a field whose value the specification does not freeze; a runner MUST skip it
